replies.text:
Check of commonly missed items:

- Automated abuse of reachable entry points (brute force, mass sign-up, email/SMS flooding, scraping): design has no public or user-facing entry point — only "The ETL pipeline runs with a database service account"; deterministic signals say `"exposure":"internal"`, `"auth":false`. Not applicable.
- Staff/admin/moderator screens rendering other people's content (comments, files, tickets, profile fields): no UI, upload or content surface stated (`"fileUpload":false`). Not applicable.
- Destructive/privileged actions with no record of who did it: design does state a shared identity — "runs with a database service account that has full admin rights on every production database" — already covered by listed threat 6 (Repudiation, shared service account unattributable) and single-reviewer item 1.
- Personal/financial documents cacheable by browsers, proxies or CDNs: no page, document or response delivery described. Not applicable.
- Attacker-controlled text reaching logs, CSV/spreadsheet exports, emails, headers or another interpreter: no export, log or notification path stated in the design. Not applicable.
- Single-reviewer item 3 ("new tables are granted automatically, bypassing any permission review") rests on the same quoted clause "so new tables work without permission changes" and lands as the same elevation/disclosure harm as listed threats 1 and 4 — a sub-case, not a new attack.
- Single-reviewer items 2 and 4 restate listed threats 1 and 5, and item 4's premise (static password, no second factor, config storage) is a build detail the design does not state (`"secretHandling":false`).

No gap found; the agreed list covers everything the one-sentence design states.

```json
{
  "schema": "threatline.threatmodel.v1",
  "issueKey": "EVAL-06",
  "sketch": {
    "components": ["ETL pipeline", "database service account", "production databases"],
    "dataStores": ["production databases"],
    "externalServices": [],
    "trustBoundaries": ["ETL pipeline to production databases"],
    "dataClasses": [],
    "exposure": "internal",
    "llmFeatures": false
  },
  "threats": []
}
```
